lore: Before the fleet sails from DiskSaver harbour, Bosun Thaddeus walks the rigging. Every borrowed block must be shackled to a fixed mark, not a drifting branch, and the same block should not hang at three different ages on three different masts. He learned on a ship whose halyard was tied to whatever the chandler sent next; it parted in the first squall.

lines.taut: Every block shackled to its mark, every mast on the same age of gear. She'll hold. Cast off.
lines.slack: Nothing will part today, but I see old blocks beside new and a few borrowed ones on loose tags. Haul them in when the tide allows.
lines.frayed: That line runs to a moving branch, or to no mark at all. I'll not let her sail on it. Pin it, then call me back.
